import { afterEach, expect, it } from '__DSH_SOURCE__/node_modules/vitest/dist/index.js'
import { mkdtemp, mkdir, realpath, rename, writeFile, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process'
import { promisify } from 'node:util'
import { appendPluginRecord, SessionId } from '__DSH_SOURCE__/packages/core/session/src/index.ts'
import { bench, testAgent, follow, sendPrompt } from '__DSH_SOURCE__/packages/experimental/client-ui-forge/tests/harness.ts'
import { WORKTREE_RECORD } from '__DSH_SOURCE__/packages/experimental/client-ui-forge/src/worktree.ts'
import * as Jsonl from '__DSH_SOURCE__/packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts'

const execute = promisify(execFile)
const cleanups: (() => Promise<unknown>)[] = []
const signal = new AbortController().signal
afterEach(async () => { for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) await cleanup() })
async function git(cwd: string, ...args: string[]) {
  return (await execute('git', ['-c', 'core.hooksPath=/dev/null', ...args], {
    cwd, timeout: 10000, maxBuffer: 65536,
    env: { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1', GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: '', GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '0', GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS: '' },
  })).stdout.trim()
}
async function fixture(pool = '.agents/worktrees/clutch') {
  const root = await realpath(await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'clutch-forge-probe-')))
  cleanups.push(() => rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }))
  const repo = join(root, 'repo')
  await mkdir(repo)
  await git(repo, 'init', '-b', 'main')
  await git(repo, '-c', 'user.name=Probe', '-c', 'user.email=probe@example.invalid', '-c', 'commit.gpgSign=false', 'commit', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'fixture')
  const baseCommit = await git(repo, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
  const path = join(repo, pool, 'wt_probe')
  await mkdir(join(repo, pool), { recursive: true })
  await git(repo, 'worktree', 'add', '-b', 'feature/probe', '--', path, baseCommit)
  const opened = await bench(repo, {}, { worktrees: true })
  cleanups.push(() => opened.ctx.fiber.dispose())
  await opened.ctx.plugin(Jsonl, { root: join(root, 'sessions'), compression: 'zstd' })
  await opened.ctx.sessionPersistence.create(opened.session.header)
  const record = { path, branch: 'feature/probe', from: 'main', baseCommit, repositoryRoot: repo }
  await opened.ctx.workingDirectory.set(opened.agent, path, signal)
  // The producer has no long-lived callback or projection: the official owner interprets its records.
  const producer = opened.ctx.plugin(() => {
    appendPluginRecord(opened.session, WORKTREE_RECORD, { action: 'request', from: record.from })
    appendPluginRecord(opened.session, WORKTREE_RECORD, { action: 'created', worktree: record })
  })
  await producer
  expect(await opened.ctx.sessions.flush(opened.session)).toBe(true)
  await producer.dispose()
  return { ...opened, root, repo, record }
}

for (const pool of ['.agents/clutch-worktrees', '.agents/worktrees/clutch']) {
  it(`official label survives producer disposal and cold replay: ${pool}`, async () => {
    const f = await fixture(pool)
    expect(f.ctx.sessionProjections.snapshot(f.session).values.forgeWorktree).toEqual(f.record)
    await f.ctx.fiber.dispose()
    const cold = await bench(f.repo, {}, { worktrees: true })
    cleanups.push(() => cold.ctx.fiber.dispose())
    await cold.ctx.plugin(Jsonl, { root: join(f.root, 'sessions'), compression: 'zstd' })
    const reader = await cold.ctx.sessionPersistence.open(f.session.id, 'read')
    const { events: seed } = await reader.read()
    await reader.close()
    const session = cold.ctx.sessions.create(f.session.id, { meta: { cwd: f.repo }, seed })
    const agent = testAgent(cold.ctx, session)
    await cold.ctx.agents.register(agent)
    expect(cold.ctx.sessionProjections.snapshot(session).values.forgeWorktree).toEqual(f.record)
    expect(cold.ctx.workingDirectory.get(session)).toBe(f.record.path)
    await rename(f.record.path, f.record.path + '-retained')
    if (pool === '.agents/clutch-worktrees') {
      await expect(cold.ctx.forgePanel.restoreWorktree(session, signal)).rejects.toThrow('configured pool')
      await cold.ctx.forgePanel.continueInProject(session, signal)
      expect(cold.ctx.workingDirectory.get(session)).toBe(f.repo)
      expect(cold.ctx.sessionProjections.snapshot(session).values.forgeWorktree).toBeNull()
    } else {
      await cold.ctx.forgePanel.restoreWorktree(session, signal)
      expect(await git(f.record.path, 'branch', '--show-current')).toBe('feature/probe')
      expect(await git(f.record.path, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')).toBe(f.record.baseCommit)
      expect(cold.ctx.sessionProjections.snapshot(session).values.forgeWorktree).toEqual(f.record)
      expect(cold.worktreeStates.stateOf(session).restoring).toBe(false)
    }
  })
}

it('official restore recreates a missing branch from baseCommit without the producer', async () => {
  const f = await fixture()
  await rename(f.record.path, f.record.path + '-retained')
  await git(f.repo, 'update-ref', '-d', `refs/heads/${f.record.branch}`)
  await f.ctx.forgePanel.restoreWorktree(f.session, signal)
  expect(await git(f.record.path, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')).toBe(f.record.baseCommit)
  expect(await git(f.record.path, 'branch', '--show-current')).toBe(f.record.branch)
})

it('two new Sessions share an official record; each held message needs its own recovery action', async () => {
  const f = await fixture()
  const second = f.ctx.sessions.create(SessionId('second'), { meta: { cwd: f.repo } })
  const agent = testAgent(f.ctx, second)
  await f.ctx.agents.register(agent)
  await f.ctx.workingDirectory.set(agent, f.record.path, signal)
  appendPluginRecord(second, WORKTREE_RECORD, { action: 'request', from: f.record.from })
  appendPluginRecord(second, WORKTREE_RECORD, { action: 'created', worktree: f.record })
  expect(f.ctx.sessionProjections.snapshot(second).values.forgeWorktree).toEqual(f.record)
  await rename(f.record.path, f.record.path + '-retained')
  const a = follow(f.ctx, f.session)
  const b = follow(f.ctx, second)
  cleanups.push(a.stop, b.stop)
  sendPrompt(f.agent, 'resume A')
  sendPrompt(agent, 'resume B')
  await Promise.all([a.until(s => s.worktree.waiting === 'restoration'), b.until(s => s.worktree.waiting === 'restoration')])
  await f.ctx.forgePanel.restoreWorktree(f.session, signal)
  await f.agent.whenIdle()
  expect(f.agent.wakes).toBe(1)
  expect(agent.wakes).toBe(0)
  await f.ctx.forgePanel.restoreWorktree(second, signal)
  await agent.whenIdle()
  expect(agent.wakes).toBe(1)
  expect(await git(f.record.path, 'branch', '--show-current')).toBe(f.record.branch)
})

it('cwd must be entered before recording request to avoid a pending official creation', async () => {
  const f = await fixture()
  const session = f.ctx.sessions.create(SessionId('bad-order'), { meta: { cwd: f.repo } })
  const agent = testAgent(f.ctx, session)
  await f.ctx.agents.register(agent)
  appendPluginRecord(session, WORKTREE_RECORD, { action: 'request', from: 'main' })
  await f.ctx.workingDirectory.set(agent, f.record.path, signal)
  const stream = follow(f.ctx, session)
  cleanups.push(stream.stop)
  const observed = await stream.until(s => s.worktree.creation !== null || s.worktree.created !== null || s.worktree.failure !== null)
  expect(observed.worktree.creation !== null || observed.worktree.created !== null || observed.worktree.failure !== null).toBe(true)
  agent.cancel({ kind: 'disposed' })
  await agent.whenIdle()
})

it('subdirectory Workspace restores with checkout-root facts, but Continue in Project goes to repository root', async () => {
  const f = await fixture()
  const original = join(f.repo, 'packages/app')
  const selected = join(f.record.path, 'packages/app')
  await mkdir(original, { recursive: true })
  await mkdir(selected, { recursive: true })
  await writeFile(join(selected, 'tracked.txt'), 'nested fixture\n')
  await git(f.record.path, 'add', 'packages/app/tracked.txt')
  await git(f.record.path, '-c', 'user.name=Probe', '-c', 'user.email=probe@example.invalid', '-c', 'commit.gpgSign=false', 'commit', '-m', 'nested fixture')
  const session = f.ctx.sessions.create(SessionId('nested'), { meta: { cwd: original } })
  const agent = testAgent(f.ctx, session)
  await f.ctx.agents.register(agent)
  await f.ctx.workingDirectory.set(agent, selected, signal)
  appendPluginRecord(session, WORKTREE_RECORD, { action: 'request', from: 'main' })
  appendPluginRecord(session, WORKTREE_RECORD, { action: 'created', worktree: f.record })
  await rename(f.record.path, f.record.path + '-retained')
  await f.ctx.forgePanel.restoreWorktree(session, signal)
  expect(await f.ctx.workingDirectory.ensure(agent)).toBe(selected)
  await f.ctx.forgePanel.continueInProject(session, signal)
  expect(f.ctx.workingDirectory.get(session)).toBe(f.repo)
  expect(session.header.cwd).toBe(original)
})
